title: User login success with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully login with correct email and password

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid email and password
Click the login button
Verify user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard

title: User login fails with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails and error message is shown with incorrect email or password

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid email or password
Click the login button
Verify error message displayed and user remains on login page

title: Role-based access control enforcement
description: Verify that users can only access modules permitted by their assigned role

steps.description: Login as a user with a specific role (e.g., Doctor)
Attempt to access restricted modules (e.g., Billing module)
Verify access is denied with appropriate error or redirect
Access allowed modules for the role
Verify successful access and full CRUD capabilities where applicable

title: Patient registration with valid data
description: Verify that a patient can be registered successfully with all mandatory fields provided

steps.description: Navigate to patient registration page
Input valid patient details including first_name, last_name, email, phone, date_of_birth, gender, and address
Submit the registration form
Verify patient is added and visible in patient list with correct details

title: Patient registration fails with missing mandatory fields
description: Verify error validation shown when mandatory fields are missing during patient registration

steps.description: Navigate to patient registration page
Leave mandatory fields (e.g., first_name or date_of_birth) empty
Submit the registration form
Verify appropriate validation error messages are displayed for missing fields

title: Create new doctor profile with valid data
description: Verify that doctors can be added with required details like department and specialization

steps.description: Navigate to doctor management section
Fill doctor creation form with valid data including first_name, last_name, email, phone, department_id, specialization
Submit the form
Verify doctor profile is created and listed correctly

title: Appointment booking with available doctor and patient
description: Ensure an appointment is successfully booked for a patient with a selected doctor at a valid future date and time

steps.description: Login as receptionist or patient
Select valid patient and doctor
Choose valid future appointment date and time
Submit appointment booking
Verify appointment is created and appears in appointment list/schedule

title: Appointment booking rejects past date/time
description: Verify system does not allow booking of appointments in the past

steps.description: Navigate to appointment booking
Select a past date/time for the appointment
Attempt to submit the appointment
Verify system displays error or prevents booking in the past

title: Bed assignment with available bed and valid patient
description: Verify assigning an available bed to a patient works and occupancy status updates accordingly

steps.description: Select a patient for bed assignment
Select an available bed from bed list
Assign bed to patient
Verify bed status shows occupied and patient assignment is logged

title: Billing invoice creation with valid items and patient
description: Verify invoices can be created with valid patient id, total amount, and invoice items

steps.description: Navigate to billing invoices section
Create new invoice with valid patient_id, total_amount, and valid line items
Submit invoice
Verify invoice is created and listed correctly with accurate totals

title: Billing invoice creation fails with invalid patient id
description: Verify invoice creation fails gracefully when patient does not exist

steps.description: Attempt to create invoice with a non-existent patient_id
Verify error response or validation message preventing invoice creation

title: Lab test request creation and retrieval
description: Verify creation of a lab test request for a patient and its retrieval in lab requests list

steps.description: Create a new lab test request with valid patient_id and test_id
Retrieve lab requests list
Verify new lab test request appears in the list with correct details

title: Medicine inventory add and retrieval
description: Verify addition of a new medicine to inventory with valid details and its visibility in medicine list

steps.description: Add a new medicine with valid name, generic_name, category_id, brand_id, and price
Retrieve medicines list
Verify the added medicine is listed with correct attributes

title: Blood bank inventory retrieval and request creation
description: Verify blood inventory status can be retrieved and that blood requests can be created

steps.description: Retrieve blood bank inventory list
Verify list contains accurate and up-to-date blood inventory details
Create a new blood request with valid data
Verify blood request is created and stored correctly

title: HR employee profile creation and payroll assignment
description: Verify employee profiles can be created and payroll records assigned correctly

steps.description: Create new employee record with required personal and department details
Assign payroll details to employee
Employee and payroll data saved and retrievable via HR dashboard

title: Inventory stock movement creation and tracking
description: Verify stock movements can be created and reflect correctly on inventory quantities

steps.description: Create stock movement entry for inventory item with in/out quantity
Verify inventory quantity updates accordingly and movement is logged

title: Radiology request creation and retrieval
description: Verify radiology test requests can be created and retrieved in reports

steps.description: Create new radiology test request with valid patient and test data
Verify request listed accurately in radiology requests report

title: IPD patient admission creation and list retrieval
description: Verify that in-patient admission records can be added and retrieved properly

steps.description: Add new IPD admission record for a patient
Retrieve IPD admissions list
Verify new IPD admission appears in the list with correct details

title: AI appointment suggestion retrieves valid recommendations
description: Verify AI-powered appointment suggestion API returns relevant appointment suggestions for given inputs

steps.description: Request AI appointment suggestions for a patient or doctor
Verify returned suggestions are relevant, logical, and well-formatted

title: Multi-language configuration applied on UI
description: Verify the system UI text changes according to selected supported languages properly

steps.description: Change system language setting to supported language (e.g., Spanish)
Verify that all UI elements display text in the selected language consistently

title: Multi-currency reflected correctly in billing and reports
description: Verify that currency setting reflects correctly on financial invoices, payments, and reports

steps.description: Set billing currency to supported alternate currency (e.g., EUR)
Create invoice and process payments
Verify all monetary values display and calculate correctly in chosen currency

title: API endpoints respond with standardized JSON format
description: Verify all REST API endpoints return valid JSON response with expected schema and error handling

steps.description: Send valid GET and POST requests to core API endpoints (e.g., /hms/patients, /hms/appointments)
Verify response status codes, content types, and response body schema correctness
Send invalid data or unauthorized requests
Verify error codes (400/401/404/etc) and standardized error JSON responses

title: Audit logs capture essential user actions
description: Verify that user actions such as login, record creation, updates, and deletions are logged correctly

steps.description: Perform critical operations (login, create patient, update appointment, delete record)
Verify audit logs record correct user, timestamp, and action details for each operation

title: System performance under high concurrency
description: Verify that system meets response time benchmarks and does not degrade under simulated concurrent user load

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent users performing common workflows (authentication, booking, billing)
Verify response times remain within acceptable limits and no request failures occur

title: Patient portal self-service booking and record viewing
description: Verify patients can book appointments, view their medical records, and billing information successfully via patient portal

steps.description: Login to patient portal with valid credentials
Book a new appointment with a doctor
Verify appointment is successfully booked and visible in portal
Navigate to medical records section
Verify medical records display accurate and complete patient data
Navigate to billing section
Verify billing statements are displayed with correct amounts and statuses

title: Integration API keys management with validation
description: Verify system allows adding, updating, and removing API integration keys securely with validation checks

steps.description: Navigate to system settings for API keys
Add new API key with valid format
Verify API key stored and displayed securely without plaintext exposure
Attempt add API key with invalid format
Verify validation error prevents submission
Delete existing API key
Verify API key removed and no longer usable

title: CMS content management CRUD operations
description: Verify CRUD operations for blog posts, galleries, careers, and testimonials in CMS module

steps.description: Create new blog post with title, content, and metadata
Verify blog post appears in blog listing
Update existing gallery content
Verify gallery reflects updated content
Delete a career posting
Verify career posting is removed and no longer accessible

title: API authentication with Sanctum token
description: Verify that API endpoints secured by Laravel Sanctum require valid authentication tokens and reject unauthorized access

steps.description: Send API request without token
Verify 401 Unauthorized response
Send API request with valid Sanctum token
Verify successful API response and access to requested data

title: System settings update and persistence
description: Verify system settings can be updated via configuration interface and persist across sessions

steps.description: Modify various system settings such as localization, timezone, and feature toggles
Save settings and logout
Login and verify modified settings are applied and persistent
Verify system operates with updated configurations consistently

title: Error handling on invalid API requests
description: Verify API returns appropriate HTTP status codes and error messages on invalid requests such as missing parameters or malformed JSON

steps.description: Send API requests missing required parameters
Verify 400 Bad Request response with detailed validation error message
Send API request with malformed JSON body
Verify 400 Bad Request or 422 Unprocessable Entity response with error details
